combatMechanics.name: Action Timeline
combatMechanics.summary: Displays upcoming turn order for allies and enemies at the top of the screen, allowing players to plan buffs, heals, and Stagger breaks before enemy turns.

combatMechanics.name: Stagger & Devastating Attack Cancel
combatMechanics.summary: Every enemy has a Stagger gauge beneath its HP bar. Hitting elemental or physical weaknesses triples Stagger damage. Depleting the gauge cancels any charging Devastating Attack, delays the enemy's turn, and increases damage taken.

combatMechanics.name: Sweeping Stagger, Extra Phase & Last Resonance
combatMechanics.summary: When all enemies in an encounter are staggered simultaneously, Sweeping Stagger triggers an Extra Phase (bonus action for every party member) followed by Resonance / Last Resonance finishers.

combatMechanics.name: Visions, Mastery Ranks (MRP) & AP
combatMechanics.summary: Characters equip crystallized Visions of classic Final Fantasy heroes. Fighting earns MRP to raise Mastery Ranks and unlock active/passive abilities equipped via Ability Points (AP). Magicite Shards (Tier 1), Magicite (Tier 2), and Magicite Crysts (Tier 3) awaken Visions.

combatMechanics.name: Summoning Espers
combatMechanics.summary: Fina summons Espers onto the battlefield as independent allies for 3 turns (one active at a time) before the Esper unleashes its signature finishing move. Each Esper also provides a 'Break the Limit' passive raising the damage cap to 99,999.

combatMechanics.name: Gold Pots & Cactuar MRP Grinding
combatMechanics.summary: Gold Pots in dungeons trade items (usually an Ether) for massive MRP to level unused Visions. Cactuars and Gigantuars (southwest Gronoa and outside Dragon's Maw) are best defeated using Noctis's Barrage (guaranteed hit). Switching to Expert difficulty before these encounters grants a 1.5x MRP multiplier.

caveMasters.name: Marauder
caveMasters.strategy: Single-target physical boss; stagger with Wind before Thwack lands.

caveMasters.name: Shoggoth
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to physical attacks. Use Earth or Water magic only, and keep Shell up against Lightning magic.

caveMasters.name: Rukh
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Earth. Use Dispel on Mighty Guard/Scatter Feathers and Light Veil to block Petrifying Gaze.

caveMasters.name: Mindflayer
caveMasters.strategy: Defeat the 2 Mind Elementals (Lv. 27, 1,800 HP, Weak: Fire) first so every break on Mindflayer is a Sweeping Stagger.

caveMasters.name: Gogmagog
caveMasters.strategy: Heavy physical bruiser. Keep Protect up and Dispel its +50% Bravery buff.

caveMasters.name: Pyroviper
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Fire; acts twice per turn. Maintain both Protect and Shell.

caveMasters.name: Salome
caveMasters.strategy: Halves Earth; acts twice per turn. Cast Fina's Light Veil before Allure to prevent party-wide Charm.

caveMasters.name: Jotunn
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to Ice. Revenge Blast scales with missing HP—save Stagger break for low HP.

caveMasters.name: Malboro Varietas
caveMasters.strategy: Immune to all status ailments. Use Light Veil before Bad Breath and burst down with Fire.

caveMasters.name: Tartarosaurus
caveMasters.strategy: Halves Earth. Uses powerful skills more frequently at low HP; save Resonance for the final phase.

caveMasters.name: Catacumba
caveMasters.strategy: Bone Toss deals 99% current HP; Disaster inflicts Doom (3-turn countdown). Open with heavy burst to lower its HP quickly.

caveMasters.name: Necromonarch
caveMasters.strategy: Counters magic attacks of its elemental weakness—use physical Fire/Light skills (e.g., Rain/Clive/Cecil) to outpace its 20% HP Rejuvenate.

caveMasters.name: Humbaba
caveMasters.strategy: Bring two healers and Light Veil for Ruthless Rampage and Rabid Claw (Confuse/Berserk).

caveMasters.name: Malboro Menace
caveMasters.strategy: Counters after a set number of Fire hits, but loses 1 action on the following turn. Keep Light Veil active before Putrid Breath.

caveMasters.name: Titanoraidos
caveMasters.strategy: Snort permanently removes a party member from battle—always break the Stagger gauge before Snort triggers.

tabletShards.exactLocationDescription: Commercial District, left of the weapon and item stalls, among crates. Take the east path from the area's main entrance.
South-west of the village, on the left-hand side of the pool.
Cross the wooden bridge east on entering; right of the stone wall ahead.
Cross the wooden bridge west, then turn left at the torch for a hidden path. Follow it up the ladder; behind the wall on the left.
Second area: down the entry steps, behind the two grey-green cylinders.
After shard 5 the bridge collapses. Win the fight, climb the ladder and the next stairs; behind the fallen stone pillar just below.
South of the Item Shop, along the wooden pier, behind barrels on the right.
Just west of the Weapon & Armour shop, at the foot of the tree.
Behind the stalagmite at the far end of the cave.
Past the fountain at the entrance, up the stairs on the right, at the ledge's edge.
Top of the first main area: after the staircases, before the room, at the end of the right-hand ledge.
Next room, up the stairs, left at the end of the visible ledge.
First side area on the left after entering, by an NPC and a gated arch with electric lights; in the corner.
Second intersection of the main area (noticeboard west, shops east), behind a pile of wooden crates.
Shipyard: up the first stairs, then up the stairs left of the main platform; at the path's end beside the ladder.
Shipyard: up the first stairs, then down the stairs right of the main platform; by the third metal girder.

On the harder route (decline Lid's 1,000 Gil offer), in plain sight round the corner past the yellowish tree from the Elven Maven sub quest. Teleport from the Save Point to the entrance to switch routes.
tabletShards.missableWarning: Route choice: either path can be taken by teleporting back to the entrance.

tabletShards.exactLocationDescription: On the easier route (pay Lid 1,000 Gil at the entrance), up the long ladder, in plain sight beside a tree. Teleport from the Save Point to the entrance to switch routes.
tabletShards.missableWarning: Route choice: either path can be taken by teleporting back to the entrance.

tabletShards.exactLocationDescription: After leaving the dungeon, from the World Map head south past the Shrine of Zidane and re-enter by the upper entrance (the Ramuh Esper route). Down the small stone ramp, hidden behind rocks.
South-west corner of the main area: cross the wooden bridge, head south, at the path's end.
North-west of the main area, down the steps to the Mom Bomb arena, then south along the path.
First area, west, behind crates.
Up the first lift, east through the fence gap into the generator room holding the second lift's switch. South-east corner, down the ladder, then west.
After the second lift, north through the area; behind the shipping container just before the next fenced lift.
First room: rather than taking the elevator ringed by four green crystals, look behind the right-hand pillar.
Further along the story path, at an elevator atop a staircase; in the gap between the staircase and its right-hand railing.
From shard 26 head south, take the next crystal elevator across, then look on the platform's left side.
Just right of the central platform on entering, beside the NPC offering boat tours.
City centre, due north of shard 28: a pool with two stone statues; by the bench behind the left statue.
From the statue pool head north-east past the giant water wheel; midway along the stone bridge, behind the plant pot.
From the statue pool (shard 29) head north up the steps; behind the tree.
On the story path, after the boat maze, at the dock on the far side of the room; immediately left, unmissable.
After the long boat maze, through the door, in front of the waterfall; the room with the Save Point and ladder.
Returning later in the story, a hidden path opens in the room left of the entrance. Up two ladders along the narrow path.
tabletShards.missableWarning: Gated: opens on a later story visit.

tabletShards.exactLocationDescription: Second room of the dungeon (the room after the Save Point when revisiting): up the stairs, east, beside the ladder.
In the room of stone platforms beneath the large waterfall, on one of the platforms.
Same room: north over the wooden bridges, on a rock between the waterfalls.
South of the Weapon and Item Shops, by the well on the small grassy island.
North of the Item Shop, before the long bridge, beside the tree on the right.
In the room with the circular central platform and four cross-shaped paths, down the north stairs once the water level is lowered.
Further on, in the boat among the water-level crystals: sail north-east past the balcony with the friendly Viridian Pot; on a ledge to the right.
After lowering the water further and descending the long ladder, just to its left.
South-west corner of the station.
Beside the station's eastern staircase entrance; you arrive next to it entering from the south on the World Map.
Castle Plaza, directly east of the tram stop.
Residential District, south-east corner.
Slums, just east of the arrival point, beside barrels.
Underground Tunnel (story): east to the metal walkway, down the stairs, then back west down the small ramp and south; in the room's corner.
tabletShards.missableWarning: Gated: reached during a story sequence.

tabletShards.exactLocationDescription: Underground Tunnel, further in: south past the Pot enemy's room to a metal bridge. A hidden entrance beneath it leads up to a room on the right.
North-west corner: Jake's room, marked by two rebel flags. Walk behind its right side for a hidden path to the crates, up the ladder, then a few paces south-west.
North-east area: facing the exit to the rebel conference room, up the stairs on the right, behind the metal pillar by the railing.
Lava-floor main area: west, up the stairs and across the platforms to a crystal switch. Press it, cross the raised girder, turn left.

Behind the left-hand horse statue of the two flanking the throne room stairs.

Storefront district (walk or teleport), directly south of the Weapon Shop beside two crates.

Entrance room, reached by the blue portal: south-west, among the writing desks.
Two steps up from the village entrance, between a bench and a pot.
Far north-east of the village, beside the snowman outside an igloo.
First room, as far west as possible, beside a fallen pillar.
Second area, south of the Save Point down the stairs, by the fallen chandelier.

Further up the spiral staircase, on one of the landings.
Higher still on the spiral staircase, on a landing before the Azure Pot enemy.
Higher again, on a snowdrift on the story path past the Azure Pot enemy.
Across the bridge into the next area, north to the small army camp; behind supplies in the bottom-right corner.
Right-hand side of the house at the town's north-western end.
Level 1 security card route (west of the main entrance room), in the room with desks and the green teleporter.

North of town, just east of the Weapon and Item Shop entrance, concealed behind the waterfall.
Leaving the first room, at the south end of the landing before either staircase.
Down the west stairs, south to the end, then east; on a staircase blocked by a fallen pillar.
From shard 84, follow the story path down the long ladder, west, up the parallel ladder, then south; against another broken pillar.

From the second Save Point, north through the door into the long room (tombstone: "The mighty wield blades, the clever command magic"). Behind the stairs on the north side, east into the hidden room under the torch, up the stairs, then up the Violet Pot enemy's ladder.

East past the item shop, under a blossom tree.

West side of the lake, under a tree.
North of the first Save Point, on the bend of the story path.
South-west of the second Save Point, at the dead end.
On the story path, after taking the left turn at the first fork past the Save Point.
Further along the story path, among stones right beside you after a cutscene.
From the entrance, follow the main path and take the first fork right.
From shard 96, left at the next fork, then the next right.
In the area where translucent bridges appear as you approach: from the third solid platform go north, then west along the bridge.
Near the dungeon's end, at the Rogue Magitek Armour fight (the enemy shown on the map).
